The name Hanadi carries the meaning “Gracious, Merciful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hanadi usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
